name: Better Aiming
author: derNeonLeon
description: Modernizes staff and binocular aiming with velocity controls, per-spell aim modes, direct spell switching, and optional C-stick aim while moving.

optionFields.name: Fire Blaster Aim Mode
optionFields.label: Fire Blaster Aim Mode
optionFields.description: Vanilla keeps the original aiming behavior while still applying speed, range, and inversion settings.

optionFields.name: Freeze Blast Aim Mode
optionFields.label: Freeze Blast Aim Mode
optionFields.description: Vanilla keeps the original aiming behavior while still applying speed, range, and inversion settings.

optionFields.name: Freeze Blast Crosshair
optionFields.label: Freeze Blast Crosshair
optionFields.description: Experimental: Reuses the Fire Blaster crosshair, so alignment may be imperfect.

optionFields.name: Direct Spell Switching
optionFields.label: Direct Spell Switching
optionFields.description: Switch directly between Fire Blaster and Freeze Blast while either spell is active.

optionFields.name: Move While Aiming
optionFields.label: Move While Aiming
optionFields.description: Experimental: In Free or Centered mode, move with the left stick and aim with the C-stick; walking has no leg animation.

optionFields.name: Blaster HUD Fix
optionFields.label: Blaster HUD Fix
optionFields.description: Prevents the HUD from briefly disappearing when firing Fire Blaster or Freeze Blast.

optionFields.name: Binocular Controls
optionFields.label: Binocular Controls
optionFields.description: Vanilla keeps the original binocular behavior while still applying speed, range, and inversion settings.

optionFields.name: Binocular Inertia
optionFields.label: Binocular Inertia
optionFields.description: Adjusts matched horizontal and vertical inertia in Modern mode.
